title: TigerBeetle Coding Standard
description: 16 non-negotiable rules applied to all production code. Each rule is machine-checkable — the agent must verify compliance before outputting code. Violations are blocks, not warnings. Waivers require explicit justification.

assertionDensity.description: Assertion density ≥ 2 per function. Assert preconditions before mutation. Assert postconditions after. Assert invariants at every boundary.
assertionDensity.check: Count assert statements in function body. Must be >= 2 for every function longer than 5 lines. Functions <= 5 lines are exempt.

noUnwrap.description: No .unwrap() in production code paths. Every fallible operation must be handled or explicitly propagated. Panic acceptable only for invariant violation (programmer error), never for runtime data.
noUnwrap.check: Search for .unwrap(), .expect(), panic!() not preceded by an invariant assertion comment.

typedErrors.description: Typed errors, not strings. Error types must be enumerated. Never return Result<(), &str> or equivalent. The caller must be able to match on the error variant.
typedErrors.check: Verify error return types are enum variants or typed error structs, never bare strings.

pairAssert.description: Pair-assert before write AND after read. After writing data, immediately read it back and assert it matches what was written.
pairAssert.check: Every write operation must be followed by a read + assert within 5 lines. Hardware lies. File systems lie. Databases lie.

noHotPathAlloc.description: No dynamic allocation on the hot path. Allocate once at initialization. The critical path must be allocation-free.
noHotPathAlloc.check: Identify hot paths (loops processing N items, request handlers). Verify no heap allocation inside them.

batchOverIndividual.description: Batching over individual operations. Process N items in a batch. One network round-trip, one filesystem sync, one lock acquisition.
batchOverIndividual.check: Verify that N operations use a single batch call, not N individual calls.

controlDataPlaneSeparation.description: Control plane / data plane separation. O(1) decisions must live outside O(N) loops. Never mix metadata computation with record processing.
controlDataPlaneSeparation.check: Verify that loop bodies contain only O(1) per-item logic. O(N) metadata computation runs before or after the loop.

maxFunctionLines.description: Function length ≤ 70 lines. Hard limit. If a function exceeds this, extract a helper.
maxFunctionLines.check: Count lines per function. Functions > 70 lines must be split.

maxLineWidth.description: Line width ≤ 100 columns. Format aggressively. If a line wraps, restructure it.

noTechDebt.description: Zero technical debt. No TODO, no FIXME, no deprecated code left in tree, no commented-out blocks.
noTechDebt.check: Search for TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, commented-out code blocks. None allowed.

unitsInNames.description: Units in variable names. latency_ms, timeout_sec, max_retries, buffer_bytes. Never latency, timeout, max, buffer.
unitsInNames.check: Verify time, size, count variables have unit suffixes.

singleSourceOfTruth.description: Single source of truth. Data lives in exactly one place. Derived state is computed on read, never stored.
singleSourceOfTruth.check: Verify no derived state is persisted. Computed values are functions, not stored fields.

explicitBoundaries.description: Explicit boundaries. Every module declares its public surface. Internal state is never leaked across module boundaries.
explicitBoundaries.check: Verify module exports are explicit. No pub fields on structs with invariants.

determinism.description: Design for determinism. Given the same inputs and same state, produce the same outputs. Seed randomness. Log seeds. Reproduce bugs from a git commit + seed.
determinism.check: Verify all RNG is seeded and the seed is logged. Verify no time.Now() or equivalent in decision paths.

noBooleanGates.description: No boolean-gated structs. A boolean field that controls whether sibling fields are meaningful is a missed sum type. Convert to a discriminated union with one variant per state. Applies across all languages: TS discriminated unions, Rust enums with data, Python Union types, Go interface type switches.
noBooleanGates.check: For every struct/interface: if a boolean field named enabled/active/valid/ready/has*/is* controls the interpretation of >=1 sibling optional field (Option<T>, T | undefined, T | null), flag it. The struct must become a sum type with named variants. Invalid states are unrepresentable at compile time.

parseAtBoundary.description: Parse at the boundary. Raw untyped payloads (unknown, Record<string, unknown>, map[string]interface{}, loose JSON) must be parsed into closed domain types at the outermost execution boundary. Downstream internal functions must never accept untyped maps, perform runtime field-existence checks, or re-validate structure.
parseAtBoundary.check: Trace each unstructured data source (API response, file read, CLI arg, LLM output, tool invocation) to its consumption. If downstream code performs typeof/instanceof/field-existence checks on data that should have been parsed at the boundary, flag it. The parse step must produce a sum type with an error variant for each failure mode.

enforcementProtocol.description: How the agent enforces this standard on code output.
enforcementProtocol.beforeOutput: Run CodingStandard.check on every changed function.
enforcementProtocol.violationResponse: Fix the violation. Do not emit the code.

waiverProtocol.description: A rule may be waived only with explicit justification.
waiverProtocol.requires: reason must explain why the rule does not apply in this specific context.
